functional_scope.signal: Portal, wizard, prefill, address validation, welcome email — multi-feature

integration.signal: HIC prefill + address validator (2 external calls)

ux_customization.signal: LWR site with custom wizard, mobile-first

size_rationale: L — several coordinated features across public + authenticated Experience Cloud with external prefill and localization.
complexity_drivers: Onboarding wizard, HIC prefill mapping, Facebook social sign-on, address validation service, gating logic, localized welcome email templates
skills_needed: LWR/Experience Cloud, Apex, Flow, integration engineer, UX designer, i18n specialist
risks: Address-validator vendor selection open (G0102); HIC prefill field mapping open (G0302); gating logic must be reliable to protect downstream data quality
solution_approach: Experience Cloud LWR site (public + authenticated). Onboarding wizard as a set of LWCs backed by an Onboarding__c staging record. Async Platform Event triggers HIC lookup on wizard entry; pending state shown while user continues; prefill applies when the event returns. Address validator (Loqate/Google TBC) via callout with cached geocode. Localized email via SF Email Templates keyed on Contact.Language_Preference__c.

process_complexity.signal: Multi-stage lifecycle with re-verification and auto-reject

size_rationale: L — well-scoped data model but LDV-aware design and complex lifecycle push above M.
complexity_drivers: 500+ treatment picker (structure TBC — G0201), medical history re-verification against prior submissions, submission → HIC-check → assignment lifecycle, patient status visibility
risks: Treatment picker performance at 500+ (G0201); LDV design must be right first time given volume
solution_approach: Custom object Subsidy_Application__c as the transactional root. Treatment_Type__c reference object with hierarchy (Specialty → Treatment). Medical_History__c child of Contact (Private OWD, see E09). Lifecycle in Flow with status field driving Service Console. Skinny table + selective index on Status + Region for reporting.

size_rationale: M — one integration, well-understood pattern, but async framing + retry policy at scale needs care.
complexity_drivers: Async pattern (Platform Event → Queueable), 15s peak latency, retry with exponential backoff, idempotency key, auto-reject rules on entitlement response, error monitoring
risks: HIC rate limits unknown (G0301); payload schema unconfirmed (G0302 — strawman only)
solution_approach: Callout wrapped in Queueable Apex, invoked from Platform Event fired at wizard entry (prefill) and application submission (entitlement check). Response written to HIC_Check__c linked to Application. Auto-reject Flow triggers when entitlement.travel_covered = true. Named Credentials with per-region endpoints if HIC exposes regional shards. Circuit breaker fallback: if HIC times out at 20s, application enters 'HIC-check pending' state and retries on schedule.

logic_complexity.signal: Geolocation match + treatment-type filter + SLA reassignment

size_rationale: XL — the 4,000-external-user scale plus geo-assignment + SLA logic plus interaction with E09 sharing model earns the top tier.
complexity_drivers: Partner Experience Cloud community for 4,000 practitioners, geolocation on Contact + Address geocoding, Apex trigger with DISTANCE()-based selection filtered by treatment specialty, Scheduled Flow reassignment on 3-business-day lapse, per-region business-day calendars
skills_needed: Partner Community architect, Apex, Geolocation/Maps expertise, License strategy
risks: Practitioner authentication method (G0401); assignment tie-breakers + capacity + leave (G0402); business-day calendar per region (G0403); 4,000 Partner Community licenses is material commercial line
solution_approach: Partner Community licenses (edition TBC in G0101). Contact-based practitioner record with Geolocation__c, Treatment_Specialty__c (junction to Treatment_Type__c), Capacity__c, On_Leave__c. On Subsidy_Application__c insert: Apex trigger enqueues Queueable that selects nearest available practitioner registered for the treatment (SOQL with DISTANCE(), filtered by not-on-leave and under capacity). Assignment__c created; practitioner notified via Community. 3-business-day acceptance clock uses Business Hours per region; Scheduled Flow at midnight scans overdue assignments and reassigns using the same logic (excluding declined-by).

size_rationale: M — replacing a PDF flow with an in-platform form is well-trodden; escalation is standard.
complexity_drivers: Digital assessment form (LWC or OmniStudio TBC), additional-specialist request mechanism, 15-day-pending escalation to Team Managers
risks: Escalation channel design (G0501 — Task vs Case vs notification); OmniStudio decision affects licensing
solution_approach: Assessment__c object linked to Assignment__c. Practitioner completes a Community-hosted LWC form (dynamic layout by treatment type). 'Request additional assessment' creates a child Assessment__c and triggers assignment logic (E04) for a specialist. Scheduled Flow at midnight checks Assessment.Status = Pending AND Assigned_Date < TODAY-15 → creates Task on Team Manager (owner via role hierarchy) + Chatter notification.

size_rationale: L — Service Console + decision support + approval hierarchy is a coordinated build.
complexity_drivers: Service Console for Assessors, subsidy amount calculator (distance × transport type × multipliers), approval process by amount threshold, managerial approval hierarchy
skills_needed: Service Cloud architect, Flow, LWC, Apex, business analyst for subsidy rules
risks: Decision-support mechanism (G0601 — BRE vs Flow); approval thresholds + hierarchy (G0602); payment integration boundary (G0603)
solution_approach: Service Console app with Subsidy_Application__c as primary tab, related Assessments + HIC results + Medical History (blocked per E09). Subsidy_Determination_Rule__c object stores per-transport-type rates. Flow computes proposed amount from Practitioner.Distance_From_Patient + Transport_Type. Approval Process routes to Manager when Amount > Threshold__c (per region config). Approval hierarchy uses Role Hierarchy with named approver override.

size_rationale: M — standard chat + bot patterns, two surfaces.
complexity_drivers: Live chat between users and PTSF Assessors; Einstein Bot flows for common questions; Knowledge base articles
skills_needed: Digital Engagement, Einstein Bots, Knowledge admin
risks: Channel choice not confirmed (G0701) — Messaging for In-App/Web assumed. Digital Engagement licenses add commercial line.
solution_approach: Messaging for In-App/Web on both Experience Cloud sites, routed to Omni-Channel queue for Assessors. Einstein Bot as first responder with intent handoff to human. Knowledge base seeded with FAQ content from the current static website. Language of chat routing derived from Contact.Language_Preference__c.

size_rationale: L — three regional AD federations plus social plus a third practitioner auth path.
complexity_drivers: Three separate SAML/OIDC federations to regional AD instances (routing based on user region); Facebook social sign-on for patients; practitioner auth path (federated vs self-register vetted — TBC)
risks: Practitioner auth method (G0401); regional-AD SSO details (G0801 — protocol, attribute mapping, JIT provisioning)
solution_approach: My Domain + SSO Auth Providers. Three Auth Providers for regional AD (SAML preferred; JIT provisioning of internal User records with region + language attributes). Facebook Auth Provider for patients. Practitioner auth: strawman = self-registration with admin-vetting workflow before Partner Community license activation.

size_rationale: L — custom Apex sharing with lifecycle events + Restriction Rules is beyond standard OWD design.
complexity_drivers: Medical_History__c with Private OWD; Apex-managed sharing granted on Assignment acceptance and revoked on close; Restriction Rules against internal profiles; break-glass audit path; Shield decision
risks: PHI classification (G0901); audit exception path (G0902); Shield decision (G0903); cross-region residency (G0904 — the biggest architecture fork)
solution_approach: Medical_History__c as child of Contact, OWD = Private, no default sharing. Apex-managed sharing (Medical_History__Share) row created by trigger on Assignment.Status = Accepted, referencing Practitioner.User_Id, RowCause = Manual. Deleted on Assignment.Status IN (Completed, Declined). Restriction Rule on Medical_History__c matching User.Profile IN (internal profiles) → No access. Break-glass: dedicated 'PHI Emergency Access' permission set that grants Read via Restriction Rule exception, with Setup Audit Trail + custom audit log. Shield Platform Encryption on selected fields (deterministic where searched).

size_rationale: XL — volume × source count × dedup complexity is the largest scope in the program.
complexity_drivers: Extract from 30 heterogeneous TAMS instances, dedup across offices, migrate patients + historical applications + assessments (many as PDF attachments), reconciliation reporting, dual-run cutover strategy
skills_needed: Migration architect, ETL specialist (MuleSoft/informatica/Data Loader at scale), data quality analyst
risks: Dedup + PDF text-extractability (G1001); office-specific customization to preserve (G1002); cutover risk with 1-month in-flight tail
solution_approach: Staging schema in an ETL tool (MuleSoft or Informatica) as the transformation hub. Per-office extract adapters. Dedup on (Name + DOB + Email + Region) with human review queue for near-matches. Bulk API 2.0 load in phased batches by region. Historical assessments loaded as ContentDocument attachments to Assessment__c records. Cutover: per-region big-bang after 4-week dual-run parallel with TAMS; in-flight apps stay in TAMS.

size_rationale: M — standard reports/dashboards, elevated by LDV considerations.
complexity_drivers: Operational dashboards (Assessor, Manager, Regional Ops) + executive KPI dashboards; volume-aware report design
skills_needed: Reports/Dashboards analyst, Data Cloud/CRM Analytics if needed for volume
risks: Requirements not stated in brief (G1101); volume may push to CRM Analytics
solution_approach: Standard reports/dashboards for tactical views. If volume-scans exceed SOQL limits, materialize via CRM Analytics or a nightly rollup pattern into Aggregate__c objects. Row-level security honors OWD (so med-history-related fields never surface).

size_rationale: L — one open architecture fork (G0904) plus real LDV design.
complexity_drivers: Single-global-org vs per-region orgs fork (G0904), LDV design (skinny tables, selective indexes, archiving of closed applications), sandbox strategy, DevOps toolchain (SFDX, CI/CD), monitoring
skills_needed: Technical Architect, DevOps engineer, LDV specialist
risks: G0904 is scope-shaping — if per-region orgs are required, this epic multiplies and cross-region assignment (E04) becomes an integration problem
solution_approach: Strawman: single global org with region as a first-class field on User/Contact, driving OWD + Restriction Rules. Sandbox tier: Full + Partial + Developer Pro. DevOps: SFDX + GitHub + CI (Copado or GitLab CI). Archiving policy: applications closed > 3 years moved to Big Objects.

size_rationale: S — Translation Workbench + per-language templates is a bounded activity.
complexity_drivers: UI translation via Translation Workbench, per-language email templates, per-region business-day calendars, language-preference propagation to chat routing
risks: Language list not specified; translation vendor process unclear
solution_approach: Translation Workbench with languages enabled per region. Email templates versioned by language, keyed by Contact.Language_Preference__c. Business Hours records per region. Chat routing via Omni-Channel skills including language attribute.
